Name: Simple UI Themes (New Update)
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b][size=4]Simple UI Themes[/size][/b]
Give Stardew Valley’s menus a softer seasonal look with [b]36 colour themes[/b], illustrated corners, trailing vines, and matching interface colours.
Choose gentle pinks, greens, creams, blues, and other seasonal palettes. Keep your favourite all year, choose a different look for each season, or let your theme change every in-game day.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]36 themes — nine per season[/b], each with matching decorative artwork.[/*]
[*]Themed menus, inventory frames, buttons, HUD elements, and tooltips.[/*]
[*]Illustrated flowers, foliage, berries, mushrooms, crystals, and seasonal details.[/*]
[*]Static glow on suitable decorations, with no animated ornaments.[/*]
[*]Optional seasonal backgrounds behind your farmer in the inventory.[/*]
[*]A colour-tile browser with decorated previews and visible selection markers.[/*]
[*]Keyboard and controller navigation in the theme picker.[/*]
[*]Support for all 12 built-in game languages.[/*]
[/list][heading]Choose how your themes change[/heading]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Use one theme throughout the year.
[b]Seasonal:[/b] Choose a separate preset for spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
[b]Daily within season:[/b] Automatically rotate through themes belonging to the current season. Eligible themes are used before the rotation repeats, and today’s choice is remembered when you reload.
Choose seasonal favourites to narrow the daily rotation. If you leave a season’s favourites empty, all nine themes are included.
Want a different look today? Use [b]Next seasonal theme[/b] or assign the optional shuffle binding. Your manual choice lasts for the current in-game day.
[heading]Preview before choosing[/heading]
Open the settings through Generic Mod Config Menu and select a preset to browse its colour tiles.
Theme names follow [b]Season - Colour - Name[/b], making the collection easier to browse. Select a tile to preview its colours and decorations, then choose [b]Select[/b] and save your settings to apply it.
[b]Cancel, Escape, or controller B[/b] leaves the picker without applying that choice.
[heading]Appearance settings[/heading]
Control menu colours, HUD colours, tooltip colours, and seasonal farmer backgrounds independently.
Decorations are included with menu theming. They adapt to supported panel layouts and available space, with pieces omitted where they cannot fit safely. There are no decoration-size or glow sliders.
Optional settings and shuffle shortcuts start unassigned.
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Simple UI Themes is cosmetic and does not change item stats, inventory capacity, or game progression.
It supports standard game menus and includes layout handling for expanded inventories and adjoining panels. NPC portrait artwork is preserved, so portrait replacements remain usable.
Custom interfaces that draw their own textures or text may need additional compatibility work. Other mods that recolour the same interface can conflict.
[b]Enable only one edition: Simple UI Themes or Simple UI Themes 2.[/b]
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI for Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]SimpleUIThemes[/b] folder into your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for the in-game settings and visual theme picker.[/*]
[/list]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. Without it, edit the generated
[code]config.json[/code]while the game is closed.
When updating, keep your existing
[code]config.json[/code]to preserve your settings.
[heading]Languages[/heading]
English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish, and Hungarian. The mod follows your game’s selected language.
[heading]Prefer darker menus?[/heading]
[b]Simple UI Themes 2[/b] offers a separate collection of 36 darker seasonal palettes with its own matching artwork.
[heading]Reporting an issue[/heading]
Please include a screenshot, your SMAPI log, the selected theme, and any mods that change the affected menu. Your resolution and UI scale are also helpful for decoration-placement issues.
